# List bucket ACL
aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket customer-data-bucket

# Download sensitive file
aws s3 cp s3://customer-data-bucket/sensitive_data.csv ./

indicators: Bucket policy with Principal set to "*" allowing s3:GetObject action
CloudTrail event PutBucketPolicy on sensitive bucket with public read statement
S3 access logs showing GET requests from IP addresses not belonging to internal network
Sensitive CSV data files containing PII (Personally Identifiable Information) publicly retrieved
IAM policy granting wildcard s3:* permissions on all resources
AWS CLI usage from external IP (203.0.113.45) downloading sensitive files
examples.detection_method: Automated CSPM tools scanning bucket policies for wildcard "Principal": "*" with read permissions, correlating with CloudTrail logs for PutBucketPolicy events and anomalous external IP S3 GET requests; scanning IAM policies for overly permissive s3:* actions; monitoring unusual data egress volumes from storage buckets; enabling S3 Block Public Access settings and alerting on deviations.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
T1078 - Valid Accounts (due to use of valid IAM credentials)
T1552 - Unsecured Credentials (misconfigured credentials allowing access)
T1218 - Signed Binary Proxy Execution (AWS CLI usage)
